# Recreating the program — every Routine, every list, the monitoring, from this repository alone

**Status: tree — generated by `node scripts/routines.mjs --write` from
`routines/manifest.json`; `check:routines` fails when regenerating
would change it. Edit the manifest, not this page.**

The Routines are the one part of the program that does not live in
git: they sit on three claude.ai subscriptions, in three Routines pages,
and no session can list another account's. Their prompts do live here,
one fenced block per lane in the runbook that is its contract, and so
do the schedules, models and bindings, in one inventory table per
program. This page joins them: for every Routine on every account, the
name to give it, when it fires, on what model, into which session, and
where its prompt is — enough for any session, on any of the three
subscriptions, to put a missing one back exactly. The lists and the
monitoring are files and workflows and come back with the clone; the
last two sections say which file is which.

## In any session, one line

Give a session on the account the line for that account. It reads
this page, prints the plan, creates what is missing, and opens the PR
that records the ids. Where a creation is refused from a session, the
same plan's `web_ui` fields are the five boxes the Routines page asks
for.

**Claude 1** (the content lanes, the two daily improvers, night shift B):

> Read docs/RECREATE.md on origin/main and run `node scripts/routines.mjs --plan claude-1 --missing`. For each Routine it prints, create it with create_trigger using exactly the arguments printed — the prompt verbatim, the schedule, the binding — or, where the binding is fresh, in this account's Routines page (claude.ai/code/routines) with the repository Cosaxo/InSight attached and the fields under web_ui; if a creation is refused, stop and tell me exactly which, so I can create it in the web UI. Then run list_triggers and open one PR that writes each new id into routines/manifest.json (trigger and state, quoted from the tool response — never from the prompt) and into the inventory table its source names, runs npm run check:routines, and requests Cosaxo. Never merge; never apply a label.

**Claude 2** (the axes program, the twelve theory lanes, the doc sweep, night shift A, the ops lanes):

> Read docs/RECREATE.md on origin/main and run `node scripts/routines.mjs --plan claude-2 --missing`. For each Routine it prints, create it with create_trigger using exactly the arguments printed — the prompt verbatim, the schedule, the binding — or, where the binding is fresh, in this account's Routines page (claude.ai/code/routines) with the repository Cosaxo/InSight attached and the fields under web_ui; if a creation is refused, stop and tell me exactly which, so I can create it in the web UI. Then run list_triggers and open one PR that writes each new id into routines/manifest.json (trigger and state, quoted from the tool response — never from the prompt) and into the inventory table its source names, runs npm run check:routines, and requests Cosaxo. Never merge; never apply a label.

**Claude 3** (the program lanes — the axiom builder, the merge shift, the console, a to-do doer, a roll call):

> Read docs/RECREATE.md on origin/main and run `node scripts/routines.mjs --plan claude-3 --missing`. For each Routine it prints, create it with create_trigger using exactly the arguments printed — the prompt verbatim, the schedule, the binding — or, where the binding is fresh, in this account's Routines page (claude.ai/code/routines) with the repository Cosaxo/InSight attached and the fields under web_ui; if a creation is refused, stop and tell me exactly which, so I can create it in the web UI. Then run list_triggers and open one PR that writes each new id into routines/manifest.json (trigger and state, quoted from the tool response — never from the prompt) and into the inventory table its source names, runs npm run check:routines, and requests Cosaxo. Never merge; never apply a label.

`node scripts/routines.mjs --plan <account>` prints every Routine of
the account with the exact `create_trigger` arguments; `--missing`
keeps only those not live; `--message <account>` prints the line
above; `--check` is the gate.

## Not yet recreatable from this branch

A Routine whose stored prompt was never written down as a block, or
lives on another branch, can be re-created only by reading the live
one (`list_triggers` returns prompts verbatim) — which is what
`docs/WORKLIST.md` asks each account to do, once, so this list empties.

- **The twelve theory lanes, second set** (Claude 3) — on `axiom-theory` as `prompts/<lane>.md`; the twelve prompts are not yet exported from Claude 2's Routines (docs/PROGRAM-RUNBOOK.md phase 4.1)

## The lists

Six files on `main`, each the owner's to run the program from
(`CLAUDE.md` § House style, D352). They come back with the clone.

| File | What it is | Who writes it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `docs/MERGE-LIST.md` | what automation built, one row per PR with *what* and *how*; the owner ticks a row to approve it | the console workflow renders it; the owner ticks |
| `docs/WORKLIST.md` | the to-do queue, one item per line tagged for the account that takes it | the owner adds; the list workers tick, one item per PR |
| `docs/PERMISSIONS.md` | every permission, secret or setting that is limiting a routine, with the exact fix | a routine appends its row; the owner changes the status word |
| `docs/OWNER-LIST.md` | what only the owner can do — decisions, clicks, designs, approvals, store and legal | routines add asks; the owner ticks |
| `docs/AXIOMS.md` | every axiom with its status — operational, explored, proposed — which licenses what may be built | routines propose; the owner moves the status word |
| `docs/VISUAL-REQUESTS.md` | every visual to be designed in Claude Design before it is built, written so the designer understands it whole | routines request; the owner refines; `docs/VISUAL-VISION.md` names the current design |

## The monitoring

| Instrument | What it does | Where it lives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The console | `.github/workflows/console.yml` → `scripts/console.mjs`, every two hours and on every push to `main`, PR label event and edit of the pinned issue titled **Console**; renders `docs/MERGE-LIST.md`, folds `docs/OWNER-LIST.md`, appends `monitoring/console-trail.jsonl`, mirrors the owner's ticks to the label `approved` | GitHub Actions — no account, no bucket; nothing to recreate but the workflow file |
| The console keeper | turns the console's data into the charted page the owner reads, twice a day | a Routine on Claude 3 — its row above |
| The roll calls | one per account, daily: which Routines fired when they should have, what they cost, and on Sundays the ledger of live prompts against their blocks | a Routine per account — their rows above; the console joins the three |
| The production reader | what the instruments said today, one comment | a Routine on Claude 2 — its row above |
| The run logs | one issue per program: **Program run log**, **Ops run log**, **Axes program run log** (#290), **doc-sweep run log** (#336), **Question farm — run log** (#31) | issues; a lane creates its own if absent, with the body its runbook prescribes |
| The pulse | `.github/workflows/pulse.yml` → `scripts/pulse.mjs`, `monitoring/pulse-trail.jsonl`, the operator gate | GitHub Actions; `docs/PULSE.md` |
